## §0 GLOBAL NON-NEGOTIABLE SYSTEM INVARIANTS

> These are ABSOLUTE. No implementation decision, shortcut, or optimization may violate any of these invariants. An implementation that violates any invariant is incorrect regardless of test passage.

### Inherited Invariants (Sprints 1–6) — ALL PRESERVED

All INV-S1-* through INV-S6-30 invariants are fully inherited. Key ones most relevant to Sprint 7 agents:

| ID | Invariant |
|---|---|
| **INV-S1-AUTH** | `req.user.id` from JWT is the ONLY source of actor identity. NEVER trust userId from request body. |
| **INV-S1-SESSION** | Session revocation requires BOTH `tokenVersion` increment AND `LoginSession.revoked = true`. Either alone is insufficient. |
| **INV-S1-AUDIT** | AuditLog is APPEND-ONLY. No `update()` or `delete()` methods exist in `AuditRepository`. |
| **INV-S3-INVENTORY** | `InventoryService` is the SOLE authority for Inventory table writes. Admin NEVER writes to inventory directly. |
| **INV-S4-OUTBOX** | All EventOutbox writes MUST be inside `$transaction` with the state change they represent. No standalone EventOutbox writes. |
| **INV-S5-SELLER** | `businessId ≠ userId`. `SellerContextGuard` resolves `userId → businessId`. Admin uses `AdminContextGuard` — no `businessId` resolution. |
| **INV-S6-CONSUMER** | `NotificationModule` is a PURE CONSUMER. Sprint 7 writes events to EventOutbox. Sprint 7 does NOT write to EventOutbox FROM within NotificationModule. |
| **INV-S6-SENDIRECT** | Admin module calls `NotificationService.sendDirect()` ONLY. NEVER calls `createAndEnqueue()` or `createInAppNotification()` directly. |
| **INV-S6-TEMPLATES** | All notification template bodies are in `TemplateSeedService.getTemplateDefinitions()`. NEVER hardcode template body in handler TypeScript. |
| **INV-S6-MAP** | `OUTBOX_EVENT_NOTIFICATION_MAP` is the ONLY way to register a new event handler. Sprint 7 adds entries. Never modifies worker routing logic. |

### New Sprint 7 Invariants

| ID | Invariant | Enforcement Location |
|---|---|---|
| **INV-S7-1** | `AdminContextGuard` MUST be the ONLY guard on all `/admin/*` routes. `SellerContextGuard` MUST NEVER appear on any admin route. | `AdminContextGuard`, all admin controllers |
| **INV-S7-2** | Every state-changing admin action MUST create an `AuditLog` entry via `AuditSafeWriterService.safeWrite()`. Direct `AuditRepository.create()` from admin services is FORBIDDEN. `safeWrite()` is called OUTSIDE `$transaction` — it manages its own error isolation via DLQ fallback. (**HARDENED H-P0-1**) | All admin services |
| **INV-S7-3** | `AuditLog.actorId` MUST always be set to `req.user.id` from the JWT claim. NEVER from request body, path param, or query param. | `AuditSafeWriterService.safeWrite()` call sites |
| **INV-S7-4** | `AuditLog.auditMonth` MUST be computed in UTC: `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7)`. Matches INV-S6-30 pattern. | `AuditRepository.create()` |
| **INV-S7-5** | `AuditLog` write failure MUST NOT block the business operation. `AuditSafeWriterService` absorbs errors silently with DLQ fallback. The state change is committed regardless. | `AuditSafeWriterService.safeWrite()` |
| **INV-S7-6** | All Sprint 7 EventOutbox events MUST use `schemaVersion: '7.0'` and `eventVersion: '1.0'`. `OrderStatusChanged` emitted by admin MUST use existing `schemaVersion: '5.0'` (existing handler). | `admin-*.service.ts` event writes |
| **INV-S7-7** | All admin PATCH endpoints that change status MUST accept and enforce `Idempotency-Key` header (UUID format). Missing header → 422. Duplicate key → 200 with original result (TTL: 86400s). | All admin state-change controllers |
| **INV-S7-8** | `KycDocument.url` stores the S3 key ONLY (e.g., `kyc-docs/userId/docId.pdf`). NEVER the full presigned URL. Signed URL is generated at API response time, never persisted. `KycDocument.publicUrl` MUST remain null. | `AdminKycService.getBusinessDetail()` |
| **INV-S7-9** | KYC document signed URLs MUST expire in ≤ 300 seconds (5 minutes). NEVER > 300 seconds. Every generation is logged in AuditLog. | `AdminKycService.generateSignedUrl()` |
| **INV-S7-10** | User suspension MUST perform ALL THREE atomically inside `$transaction`: `User.isDeleted = true`, `User.tokenVersion += 1`, `LoginSession.revoked = true` (all sessions for that user). Any one step alone is insufficient. | `AdminUserService.suspendUser()` |
| **INV-S7-11** | Admin CANNOT suspend their own account. Admin CANNOT change their own role. Explicit guard: `if (targetUserId === req.user.id) throw ForbiddenException`. | `AdminUserService.suspendUser()`, `changeRole()` |
| **INV-S7-12** | `PATCH /admin/users/:id/change-role` Zod schema MUST reject `ADMIN` and `SELLER_MANAGER` as target roles. Only `BUYER` and `SELLER` are valid targets. | `AdminChangeRoleDto` schema |
| **INV-S7-13** | `validateAdminTransition()` is a NEW PURE FUNCTION in `order-state-machine.ts`. It MUST NOT modify `validateSellerTransition()` or `SELLER_VALID_TRANSITIONS`. Admin transitions are: any non-terminal → CANCELLED (with reason), SHIPPED → DELIVERED, DELIVERED → COMPLETED. | `order-state-machine.ts` |
| **INV-S7-14** | Seller payout rates MUST come from `FeatureFlag` values — NEVER hardcoded constants. Keys: `platform_commission_percent` (default 2), `tds_rate_percent` (default 1), `payment_gateway_fee_percent` (default 2). | `AdminPayoutService.calculatePayout()` |
| **INV-S7-15** | `SellerPayout` MUST have `@@index([orderId])` only — NEVER `@@unique` on `orderId`. Multi-seller future requires N payouts per order. | Prisma schema (verified) |
| **INV-S7-16** | Invoice PDF generation using `pdf-lib`. If generation exceeds 2000ms: enqueue to BullMQ `invoice-generation` queue. Return 202 with `{ invoiceId, status: 'GENERATING' }`. Block HTTP cycle only if < 2000ms. | `AdminInvoiceService.generateInvoice()` |
| **INV-S7-17** | `POST /admin/invoices/generate/:orderId` is the ONLY way to trigger invoice generation. Automatic invoice on order COMPLETED is Sprint 9 scope. | Sprint 7 scope boundary |
| **INV-S7-18** | Feature flag cache key: `flag:{name}:{env}:{segment}` TTL=300s. Cache invalidation on toggle: SCAN + DEL matching keys (not pattern delete). All flag reads: Redis first, DB fallback. | `AdminFlagService.isEnabled()` |
| **INV-S7-19** | Admin KYC notification (`KycApproved`, `KycRejected`) MUST be sent OUTSIDE the `$transaction` via `sendDirect()`. If `sendDirect()` fails: log error, DO NOT roll back. Business is verified regardless. | `AdminKycService.verifyBusiness()` |
| **INV-S7-20** | `POST /admin/products/bulk-approve` batch MUST be capped at 100 productIds. Larger batches → 422 with `{ code: 'BATCH_SIZE_EXCEEDED', max: 100 }`. Each individual approval is atomic independently. | `AdminProductController.bulkApprove()` |
| **INV-S7-21** | `ProductStateMachineService.validateTransition()` MUST be called before any admin product status change. Admin NEVER bypasses the product state machine. | `AdminProductService.approve()`, `reject()` |
| **INV-S7-22** | `GET /admin/audit-logs` MUST be cursor-paginated (by `AuditLog.id`). NEVER unbounded. Max `limit: 100`. | `AdminAuditController`, `AdminAuditRepository` |
| **INV-S7-23** | `AuditRepository` MUST have NO `update()`, `delete()`, or `upsert()` methods. Immutability is enforced by method absence. | `AuditRepository` |
| **INV-S7-24** | DLQ queue name is LOCKED as `notifications-failed` (from Sprint 6 AUDIT-S6-3). Admin reads from this name. Never alias. Never rename. | `AdminExceptionService.getDlqJobs()` |
| **INV-S7-25** | Admin module MUST import ONLY: `PrismaModule`, `RedisModule`, `BullMQModule`, `S3Module`, `NotificationModule`, `ObservabilityModule`, `SecurityModule` (AuditModule). FORBIDDEN imports: OrderModule, InventoryModule, SellerModule, BuyerModule, PaymentModule, CatalogModule, CartModule. | `AdminModule` imports |
| **INV-S7-26** | Admin cross-domain reads (orders, products, users, businesses) MUST use direct Prisma access. NEVER import domain modules for data access. | All `admin-*.repository.ts` |
| **INV-S7-27** | Session revocation after user suspension MUST also delete Redis key `seller_biz:{userId}` to prevent stale SellerContextGuard cache. | `AdminUserService.suspendUser()` |
| **INV-S7-28** | `EventOutbox.deduplicationKey` for Sprint 7 events MUST follow format: `{eventType}:{entityId}:{adminUserId}`. Deterministic, idempotent, admin-actor-scoped. | All admin EventOutbox writes |
| **INV-S7-29** | `Notification.status` field MUST be updated to `SENT` on delivery success and `FAILED` on DLQ. `NotificationWorker` owns this update. The field defaults to `PENDING` on record creation. | `NotificationWorker.process()` |
| **INV-S7-30** | `buyerCode` in `OrderCreatedPayloadSchema` is `z.string().optional()`. When present, it is set from `maskBuyerId(order.buyerId)` in `orders.service.ts`. Seller templates MAY display it. It is masked — NEVER the raw `buyerId`. | `outbox-payloads.schemas.ts`, `orders.service.ts` |
| **INV-S7-31** | `NotificationListQuerySchema` MUST include `dateFrom: z.string().datetime().optional()` and `dateTo: z.string().datetime().optional()`. Admin user-notification audit: `GET /admin/users/:id/notifications?dateFrom=&dateTo=` MUST pass explicit `userId` — never scope-free. | `notification.schemas.ts`, `NotificationController` |
| **INV-S7-32** | `Notification.status` Prisma migration: `enum NotificationDeliveryStatus { PENDING SENT FAILED }`. Field: `status NotificationDeliveryStatus @default(PENDING)`. Migration name: `20260601_sprint7_notification_status`. | `packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma` |
| **INV-S7-33** | Admin `GET /admin/businesses/:id` MUST log AuditLog entry: `{ action: AuditAction.UPDATE, entityType: 'KycDocument', entityId: businessId, newValue: { action: 'KYC_DOCUMENTS_VIEWED', docCount: N } }` if KYC documents are returned. PII access must leave a forensic trace. `AuditAction.READ` does NOT exist in schema enum — use `AuditAction.UPDATE` with metadata strategy. (**HARDENED H-P0-2**) | `AdminKycService.getBusinessDetail()` |
| **INV-S7-34** | Exception center data is NOT cached in Redis. Computed on each request. Fresh data is more important than caching here (exceptions are rare, stale exception counts mislead). | `AdminExceptionService.getExceptions()` |
| **INV-S7-35** | `SellerPayout` creation MUST be called synchronously within the `$transaction` that marks `Order.status = COMPLETED`. Payout record creation and order completion are atomic. **CRITICAL: `SellerPayout.sellerId` expects `User.id`. `Order.sellerId` is `Business.id`. The tx MUST resolve `Business.ownerId` before creating payout: `const biz = await tx.business.findUnique({ where: { id: order.sellerId }, select: { ownerId: true } })`. Use `biz.ownerId` as `sellerId`.** (**HARDENED H-P0-3**) | `AdminOrderService.markComplete()` |
| **INV-S7-36** | `JwtAuthGuard` MUST check `user.isDeleted` on every request. A suspended user with `isDeleted = true` MUST receive `401 Unauthorized` even with a valid JWT. The `tokenVersion` increment alone is insufficient: a suspended admin retains access within the JWT TTL window unless `isDeleted` is checked. Confirm `JwtStrategy.validate()` fetches user from DB and asserts `!user.isDeleted`. (**HARDENED H-P1-7**) | `JwtStrategy.validate()`, `JwtAuthGuard` |
| **INV-S7-37** | `OrderStatusHistory.actorRole` is typed as `SystemActorType`. `SystemActorType` MUST include `ADMIN` — **VERIFIED in source:** `SystemActorType.ADMIN = 'ADMIN'` exists in `packages/types/src/enums/index.ts`. All admin status history writes MUST use `actorRole: SystemActorType.ADMIN`. (**HARDENED H-P1-8**) | `AdminOrderRepository`, `OrderStatusHistoryRepository` |
| **INV-S7-38** | Every `tx.eventOutbox.create()` in Sprint 7 MUST include `eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date())`. `EventOutbox.eventMonth` is a non-nullable `String` field with NO default in schema. Omitting it causes Prisma `P2002` required field error at runtime. (**AUDIT-P0-A**) | All admin services writing to `EventOutbox` |

## §2 SPRINT 1–6 INHERITANCE CONTRACT

The following Sprint 1–6 patterns are inherited without modification. Any Sprint 7 code that deviates from these patterns is incorrect.

### Auth Pattern (Sprint 1)
```typescript
// CORRECT — always extract userId from JWT
const userId = req.user.id; // Set by JwtAuthGuard

// FORBIDDEN — never trust body for actor identity
const userId = req.body.actorId; // ❌ P0 security violation
```

### Guard Stack Pattern
```typescript
// Domain routes
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.BUYER, UserRole.SELLER)

// Seller routes only
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard, SellerContextGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.SELLER)

// Admin routes — Sprint 7 pattern
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AdminContextGuard)  // ← NO RolesGuard needed (AdminContextGuard checks role internally)
```

### EventOutbox Write Pattern (Sprint 4/5 — Admin now writes events)
```typescript
// CORRECT — admin EventOutbox write pattern (Sprint 7)
await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  await tx.business.update({ where: { id }, data: { kycStatus: KycStatus.VERIFIED } });
  await tx.eventOutbox.create({
    data: {
      eventType: 'BusinessVerified',
      payload: { ...payload } as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
      schemaVersion: '7.0',          // INV-S7-6
      eventVersion: '1.0',           // INV-S7-6
      deduplicationKey: `BusinessVerified:${id}:${adminUserId}`, // INV-S7-28
      eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),  // AUDIT-P0-A: REQUIRED non-nullable field
      status: EventStatus.PENDING,
    },
  });
  // NOTE: safeWrite() is NOT called inside $transaction (H-P0-1 — safeWrite has no tx param)
}); // ← $transaction closes here

// AFTER $transaction commits:
await auditWriter.safeWrite({ ... }); // INV-S7-2 — safeWrite OUTSIDE $transaction
await notificationService.sendDirect(sellerUserId, 'KycApproved_SELLER_hi', { businessName }); // INV-S7-19
```

### AuditLog Write Pattern (Sprint 7 mandatory)
```typescript
// ALWAYS via AuditSafeWriterService — NEVER direct AuditRepository
await this.auditWriter.safeWrite({
  actorId: req.user.id,           // INV-S7-3 — JWT only
  action: AuditAction.STATUS_CHANGE,
  entityType: 'Business',
  entityId: businessId,
  entityName: business.name,
  oldValue: { kycStatus: old.kycStatus },
  newValue: { kycStatus: 'VERIFIED', reason: undefined },
  ipAddress: req.ip,
  userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] as string,
  sessionId: req.user.sessionId,
  // auditMonth set automatically by AuditRepository.create() — INV-S7-4
});
```

## §3 SCHEMA CHANGES & MIGRATIONS

### 3.1 Required Migration: Notification Status

**File:** `packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma`

**Migration name:** `20260601_sprint7_notification_status`

```prisma
// ADD to schema.prisma:

enum NotificationDeliveryStatus {
  PENDING
  SENT
  FAILED
}

// MODIFY Notification model — add:
model Notification {
  // ... existing fields ...
  status NotificationDeliveryStatus @default(PENDING)  // INV-S7-32

  @@index([userId, status], map: "idx_notif_user_status")  // supports admin audit query
}

// MODIFY SupportTicket model — add (AUDIT-P1-B, H-P2-9):
model SupportTicket {
  // ... existing fields ...
  resolvedNote String?  // Admin's resolution message. Set when status=RESOLVED.
}
```

## §4 TRANSACTION BOUNDARY GOVERNANCE

All Sprint 7 admin state changes MUST follow this transaction boundary:

```
INSIDE $transaction:
  1. Read current state (for oldValue in AuditLog)
  2. Validate state transition (state machine or explicit guard)
  3. Validate Idempotency-Key not previously processed (Redis read — pre-tx if possible)
  4. Update primary entity (Business/Product/User/Order status)
  5. Create EventOutbox event with eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()) — REQUIRED field

OUTSIDE $transaction (after commit):
  6. AuditSafeWriterService.safeWrite() — non-transactional, DLQ-backed (AUDIT-P0-A, H-P0-1)
  7. Store Idempotency-Key result in Redis — best-effort
  8. NotificationService.sendDirect() — non-blocking (INV-S7-19)
  9. Delete Redis cache keys (seller_biz:{userId}, flag:{name}) — best-effort
```

> **AUDIT-P0-A INVARIANT:** Every `tx.eventOutbox.create()` in Sprint 7 MUST include `eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date())`. This is a non-nullable field with no default in schema. Omission causes Prisma `P2002` required field error at runtime. Import `formatYearMonth` from `order-state-machine.ts` or extract to `@vyaparnet/utils`.

### Atomicity Requirements

| Action | $transaction Contents | Post-Transaction |
|---|---|---|
| Business verify | `Business.kycStatus = VERIFIED` + `EventOutbox(BusinessVerified)` + `AuditLog` | `sendDirect(KycApproved)` + cache invalidation |
| Business suspend | `Business.kycStatus = SUSPENDED` + `EventOutbox(BusinessSuspended)` + `AuditLog` | `sendDirect(BusinessSuspended)` |
| Product approve | `Product.status = ACTIVE`, `approvedBy`, `approvedAt` + `EventOutbox(ProductApproved)` + `AuditLog` | `sendDirect(ProductApproved)` |
| Product reject | `Product.status = REJECTED` + `EventOutbox(ProductRejected)` + `AuditLog` | `sendDirect(ProductRejected)` |
| User suspend | `User.isDeleted = true` + `User.tokenVersion += 1` + `LoginSession` bulk revoke + `EventOutbox(UserSuspended)` + `AuditLog` | `sendDirect(AccountSuspended)` + delete `seller_biz:{userId}` |
| Order DELIVERED | `Order.status = DELIVERED` + `OrderStatusHistory` append + `EventOutbox(OrderStatusChanged)` + `AuditLog` | existing NotificationModule handles notification |
| Order COMPLETED | `Order.status = COMPLETED` + `OrderStatusHistory` append + `SellerPayout` create + `PlatformCommission` create + `AuditLog` | payout record created (status: PENDING) |
| Feature flag toggle | `FeatureFlag.enabled` update + `AuditLog` | Redis cache DEL for flag keys |
| Payout initiate | `SellerPayout.status = INITIATED` + `AuditLog` | — |
| KYC doc view | — (read-only) | `AuditLog` (KYC access log) |

## §5 REDIS KEY REGISTRY (SPRINT 7)

Complete Sprint 1–7 Redis key registry:

| Sprint | Key Pattern | TTL | Owner | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `otp:{phone}` | 300s | OtpService | OTP storage |
| 1 | `ratelimit:otp:{phone}` | 300s | OtpService | OTP rate limit |
| 1 | `lockout:{phone}` | 900s | OtpService | Account lockout |
| 1 | `session:{userId}:{deviceId}` | 604800s | TokenService | Session storage |
| 3/4 | `idem:{hash}` | 86400s | InventoryService | Inventory idempotency |
| 4 | `idempotency:{hash}` | 3600s | PaymentService | Payment idempotency |
| 5 | `seller_biz:{userId}` | 60+jitter s | SellerContextGuard | Business cache |
| 5 | `kpi:{businessId}:{segment}:{date}` | 60+jitter s | SellerKpiService | KPI cache |
| 5 | `status-transition:{orderId}:{toStatus}:{key}` | 86400s | SellerOrderService | Transition idempotency |
| 5 | `seller_score:{businessId}` | 360s | SellerScorecardService | Score cache |
| 6 | `notif:{userId}:{eventType}:{entityId}` | 300s | DeduplicationService | Notification dedup |
| 6 | `notif:lowstock:{productId}:{businessId}` | 86400s | StockLow handler | Stock rate limit |
| 6 | `outbox-processed:{eventId}` | 86400s | OutboxConsumerWorker | Event idempotency |
| 6 | `notif:pref:{userId}` | 300s | NotificationPreferenceService | Pref cache |
| 6 | `notif:unread-count:{userId}` | 30s | NotificationRepository | Unread count cache |
| 6 | `cb:sms:open` / `cb:email:open` | 120s | CircuitBreakerService | Circuit state |
| **7** | **`admin-idem:{key}`** | **86400s** | **AdminIdempotencyService** | **Admin action idempotency** |
| **7** | **`flag:{name}:{env}:{segment}`** | **300s** | **AdminFlagService** | **Feature flag cache** |
| **7** | **`admin-rate:{adminId}:{minute}`** | **60s** | **AdminRateLimitGuard** | **Admin rate limit** |

**Namespace analysis:** `admin-idem:`, `flag:`, `admin-rate:` — zero collision with any Sprint 1–6 prefix.

## §8 PUBLIC API CONTRACT REFERENCE

All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {jwt}` + `@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AdminContextGuard)`.

State-changing PATCH/POST routes require `Idempotency-Key: {uuid}` header.

### Business Verification APIs

```
GET    /admin/businesses
       Query: ?kycStatus=PENDING&segment=TEXTILE&cursor=&limit=20
       Response: { data: BusinessSummaryDto[], nextCursor, total }

GET    /admin/businesses/:id
       Response: { business: BusinessDetailDto, kycDocs: KycDocumentDto[], signedUrls: Record<docId, signedUrl> }
       AuditLog: READ action on KycDocument (INV-S7-33)

PATCH  /admin/businesses/:id/verify
       Headers: Idempotency-Key
       Body: {}
       Response: { business: BusinessDetailDto }
       Tx: Business.kycStatus=VERIFIED + EventOutbox(BusinessVerified) + AuditLog
       Post-tx: sendDirect(KycApproved_SELLER_hi)

PATCH  /admin/businesses/:id/reject
       Headers: Idempotency-Key
       Body: { reason: string }     // MANDATORY — minimum 10 chars
       Tx: Business.kycStatus=REJECTED + EventOutbox(BusinessRejected) + AuditLog
       Post-tx: sendDirect(KycRejected_SELLER_hi)

PATCH  /admin/businesses/:id/suspend
       Headers: Idempotency-Key
       Body: { reason: string }
       Tx: Business.kycStatus=SUSPENDED + EventOutbox(BusinessSuspended) + AuditLog

PATCH  /admin/businesses/:id/reactivate
       Headers: Idempotency-Key
       Body: {}
       Tx: Business.kycStatus=VERIFIED + AuditLog
```

### New Notification Handlers

Each handler follows the established pattern from Sprint 6:
```typescript
// Example: apps/api/src/modules/notification/handlers/business-verified.handler.ts
export async function handleBusinessVerified(
  payload: BusinessVerifiedPayload,
  ctx: HandlerContext,
): Promise<void> {
  const { businessId, businessName, sellerUserId } = payload;

  const dedupKey = `notif:${sellerUserId}:BusinessVerified:${businessId}`;
  if (await ctx.deduplicationService.isDuplicate(dedupKey)) return;

  const contact = await ctx.userContactService.getContact(sellerUserId);
  if (!contact) return;

  await ctx.notificationService.createAndEnqueue({
    userId: sellerUserId,
    contact,
    templateName: 'KycApproved_SELLER_hi',
    variables: { businessName },
    entityId: businessId,
    eventType: 'BusinessVerified',
    channels: ['sms', 'in_app', 'email'],
    segment: payload.segment ?? 'default',
  });

  await ctx.deduplicationService.markProcessed(dedupKey);
}
```

## §10 SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

### 10.1 Privilege Escalation Prevention

```typescript
// AdminContextGuard — sole gate for all admin routes
@Injectable()
export class AdminContextGuard implements CanActivate {
  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const user = request.user;
    if (!user || user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED', message: 'Admin role required' });
    }
    // No businessId resolution — admin is platform-scoped, not business-scoped (INV-S7-1)
    return true;
  }
}

// AdminChangeRoleDto — role escalation prevention (INV-S7-12)
export const AdminChangeRoleDtoSchema = z.object({
  role: z.enum(['BUYER', 'SELLER']), // ADMIN and SELLER_MANAGER are FORBIDDEN
}).strict();

// Self-modification prevention (INV-S7-11)
if (targetUserId === req.user.id) {
  throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'ADMIN_SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN' });
}
```

### 10.2 KYC Document Security

```typescript
// CORRECT — S3 key stored, signed URL generated at runtime (INV-S7-8, INV-S7-9)
const signedUrl = await this.s3Service.getSignedUrl(doc.url, 300); // 300s = 5 min max

// FORBIDDEN — storing signed URL in DB
await prisma.kycDocument.update({ data: { publicUrl: signedUrl } }); // ❌ NEVER

// FORBIDDEN — returning public URL
return { url: `https://s3.amazonaws.com/bucket/${doc.url}` }; // ❌ NEVER

// AuditLog on KYC document access (INV-S7-33)
await this.auditWriter.safeWrite({
  actorId: adminUserId,
  action: AuditAction.UPDATE,  // H-P0-2: AuditAction.READ does NOT exist. Use UPDATE + metadata strategy.
  entityType: 'KycDocument',
  entityId: businessId,
  entityName: business.name,
  oldValue: null,
  newValue: { action: 'KYC_DOCUMENTS_VIEWED', docCount: docs.length }, // forensic metadata
  ipAddress: req.ip,
  userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] as string,
});
// NOTE (H-P0-2): AuditAction enum = { CREATE UPDATE DELETE STATUS_CHANGE LOGIN LOGOUT
// FAILED_LOGIN PASSWORD_RESET PERMISSION_CHANGE }. No READ value exists.
// READ_SENSITIVE access is modeled as AuditAction.UPDATE with descriptive newValue metadata.
// Do NOT attempt to use AuditAction.READ — it will fail TypeScript compilation.
```

### 10.3 Session Revocation (INV-S7-10, INV-S7-27)

```typescript
// In AdminUserService.suspendUser() — inside $transaction
await tx.user.update({
  where: { id: targetUserId },
  data: {
    isDeleted: true,
    tokenVersion: { increment: 1 },  // INV-S7-10 — JWT invalidation
  },
});

await tx.loginSession.updateMany({
  where: { userId: targetUserId, revoked: false },
  data: {
    revoked: true,
    revokedAt: new Date(),
    revokeReason: 'ADMIN_SUSPENSION',
  },
});

// After $transaction commits — cache invalidation (INV-S7-27)
await this.redis.del(`seller_biz:${targetUserId}`).catch(() => {});
```

### 10.4 Admin Rate Limiting

```typescript
// AdminRateLimitGuard — 60 requests/minute per admin IP
// Key: `admin-rate:{adminId}:{minute}` TTL=60s
// On exceed: 429 with Retry-After header
```

### 10.5 Idempotency Enforcement

```typescript
// AdminIdempotencyService
async checkAndSet(key: string, result: unknown): Promise<{ isDuplicate: boolean; cachedResult?: unknown }> {
  const cacheKey = `admin-idem:${key}`;
  const existing = await this.redis.get(cacheKey);
  if (existing) {
    return { isDuplicate: true, cachedResult: JSON.parse(existing) };
  }
  await this.redis.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(result), 'EX', 86400);
  return { isDuplicate: false };
}
```

### 10.6 Audit Log Immutability Enforcement

```typescript
// AuditRepository — CONFIRMED: no update() or delete() methods (INV-S7-23)
// AdminAuditRepository — inherits same constraint (read-only query layer)
// Any PR adding update()/delete() to AuditRepository is a P0 security violation
```

### 10.7 Security Attack Surface Summary

| Attack Vector | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Admin privilege escalation | `AdminContextGuard` + Zod role whitelist in `change-role` |
| Unauthorized KYC document access | S3 signed URL (300s), AuditLog on access |
| Audit log tampering | No `update()`/`delete()` in `AuditRepository` ever |
| Session hijack post-suspension | `tokenVersion` increment kills all JWTs |
| Double-approve/reject | `Idempotency-Key` + Redis `admin-idem:{key}` TTL=86400s |
| Admin DoS on platform | Rate limit 60 req/min per IP |
| Replay attack on admin actions | `Idempotency-Key` prevents replay within 24h |
| Event spoofing | `deduplicationKey: {eventType}:{entityId}:{adminUserId}` |
| Batch amplification | Bulk approve capped at 100 |
| Feature flag abuse | AuditLog on every flag toggle; flag change requires admin JWT |

## §12 SCALABILITY ARCHITECTURE

### 12.1 Admin Query Performance

| Query | Current Scale (100 sellers) | Future Scale (10,000 sellers) | Index Strategy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /admin/businesses?kycStatus=PENDING` | < 10ms | < 50ms | `idx_kyc_biz_status` (existing) |
| `GET /admin/products?status=PENDING_APPROVAL` | < 10ms | < 100ms | `idx_prod_seg_cat_act` + `status` filter |
| `GET /admin/orders` (cross-seller) | < 50ms | < 500ms | `idx_order_status_updated` |
| `GET /admin/exceptions` (stuck orders) | < 100ms | < 200ms | `idx_order_status_updated` |
| `GET /admin/audit-logs` | < 50ms | < 500ms | `idx_al_entity_date` (existing) |
| Invoice PDF generation | < 2s → async | Queue-based | BullMQ `invoice-generation` |

### 12.2 AuditLog Scalability

`AuditLog` has `auditMonth` partition-ready key. At 10,000 sellers with 50 admin actions/day:
- Monthly audit log rows: ~1.5M
- With `idx_al_entity_date` and `idx_al_actor_date` indexes: p99 < 100ms at 1M rows
- Sprint 9: actual PostgreSQL table partitioning by `auditMonth`

### 12.3 Feature Flag Scalability

Redis TTL=300s means at most 300s stale flag state. For 10,000 concurrent users:
- 33 Redis reads/second (100% cache hit rate after warm-up)
- On admin toggle: SCAN + DEL ≈ 5-10 keys max — negligible latency

### 12.4 Invoice Generation Scalability

PDF generation has variable latency. Sprint 7 strategy:
- < 2000ms: return synchronously (most invoices)
- ≥ 2000ms: return 202, queue to `invoice-generation` BullMQ worker (INV-S7-16)
- 1 worker instance in MVP. Horizontally scalable by adding workers in Sprint 9.

### 12.5 Multi-Seller Compatibility

Per `SPRINT_7_SCOPE_DECISIONS.md §MS`:
- `SellerPayout.orderId` has `@@index` ONLY — NOT `@@unique` (INV-S7-15)
- Admin payout API resolves seller via `Business.ownerId` (not `Order.sellerId` directly)
- All admin filters use `segment` dimension for future multi-segment isolation
- `validateAdminTransition()` is a pure function — callable from multi-seller orchestration

## §13 GOVERNANCE ARCHITECTURE

### 13.1 Every Admin Action = One AuditLog Entry

| Action | AuditAction | entityType | oldValue | newValue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verify business | STATUS_CHANGE | Business | `{kycStatus: 'PENDING'}` | `{kycStatus: 'VERIFIED'}` |
| Reject business | STATUS_CHANGE | Business | `{kycStatus: 'PENDING'}` | `{kycStatus: 'REJECTED', reason}` |
| Suspend business | STATUS_CHANGE | Business | `{kycStatus: 'VERIFIED'}` | `{kycStatus: 'SUSPENDED', reason}` |
| Approve product | STATUS_CHANGE | Product | `{status: 'PENDING_APPROVAL'}` | `{status: 'ACTIVE', approvedBy}` |
| Reject product | STATUS_CHANGE | Product | `{status: 'PENDING_APPROVAL'}` | `{status: 'REJECTED', reason}` |
| Suspend user | STATUS_CHANGE | User | `{isDeleted: false}` | `{isDeleted: true, reason}` |
| Activate user | STATUS_CHANGE | User | `{isDeleted: true}` | `{isDeleted: false}` |
| Change user role | STATUS_CHANGE | User | `{role: oldRole}` | `{role: newRole}` |
| Deliver order | STATUS_CHANGE | Order | `{status: 'SHIPPED'}` | `{status: 'DELIVERED', actorRole: 'ADMIN'}` |
| Complete order | STATUS_CHANGE | Order | `{status: 'DELIVERED'}` | `{status: 'COMPLETED'}` |
| Force-cancel order | STATUS_CHANGE | Order | `{status: oldStatus}` | `{status: 'CANCELLED', reason}` |
| Toggle feature flag | UPDATE | FeatureFlag | `{enabled: false}` | `{enabled: true}` |
| Initiate payout | STATUS_CHANGE | SellerPayout | `{status: 'PENDING'}` | `{status: 'INITIATED'}` |
| Resolve ticket | STATUS_CHANGE | SupportTicket | `{status: 'OPEN'}` | `{status: 'RESOLVED'}` |
| View KYC docs | UPDATE | KycDocument | null | `{action: 'KYC_DOCUMENTS_VIEWED'}` |
| DLQ job retry | UPDATE | NotificationJob | `{status: 'failed'}` | `{status: 'RETRIED'}` |

### 13.2 AuditLog Query Patterns

```typescript

GET /admin/audit-logs/timeline/Business/{businessId}
→ AuditRepository.findByEntity('Business', businessId)
→ ORDER BY createdAt ASC

// Filter by admin actor
GET /admin/audit-logs?actorId={adminId}&dateFrom=2026-06-01&dateTo=2026-06-30

// Filter by action type
GET /admin/audit-logs?action=STATUS_CHANGE&entityType=Business
```

## §14 ADMIN DASHBOARD vs OPERATIONS DASHBOARD SEPARATION

This section formalizes the architectural boundary required by the user's CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENT.

### Conceptual Separation

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ADMIN DASHBOARD (Business Ops)                    │
│                    /admin/* routes                                    │
│  AuditLog, KYC state, Product queues, User management               │
│  Payout records, Ticket management, Business governance              │
│  Source of truth: PostgreSQL business tables                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              ≠
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  OPERATIONS DASHBOARD (Technical Ops)                │
│                  /ops/* routes (future Sprint 9)                     │
│  Queue depth, Worker health, EventOutbox pipeline, Redis health      │
│  Notification DLQ, Circuit breaker state, API latencies             │
│  Source of truth: Prometheus metrics, BullMQ, Redis                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Sprint 7 Implementation (Unified MVP)

Sprint 7 implements a unified admin view. The DLQ visibility sits under `/admin/exceptions/dlq` for convenience in MVP.

**Architectural preservation rules (CRITICAL):**
1. DLQ data (`/admin/exceptions/dlq`) returns BullMQ job metadata only — NOT business entity state
2. Audit logs are business-layer data — they are NOT system metrics
3. Exception center mixes both domains deliberately in MVP — Sprint 9 will separate into two distinct dashboards
4. The `AdminExceptionService` is structured with TWO separate method groups:
   - `getBusinessExceptions()` → business state queries (stuck orders, failed payments)
   - `getTechnicalExceptions()` → BullMQ depth, DLQ jobs
5. Sprint 9 can extract `getTechnicalExceptions()` into a separate `OpsExceptionService` without modifying `getBusinessExceptions()`

```typescript
// (NOT inline in AdminKycService — export it for testability)
export const ADMIN_KYC_TRANSITIONS: Record<KycStatus, KycStatus[]> = {
  PENDING: [KycStatus.VERIFIED, KycStatus.REJECTED],
  VERIFIED: [KycStatus.SUSPENDED],
  SUSPENDED: [KycStatus.VERIFIED],
  REJECTED: [KycStatus.PENDING],  // Seller resubmits → triggers PENDING
  UNVERIFIED: [KycStatus.PENDING], // Seller uploads first doc
};

export function validateAdminKycTransition(current: KycStatus, next: KycStatus): void {
  if (!ADMIN_KYC_TRANSITIONS[current]?.includes(next)) {
    throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'INVALID_KYC_TRANSITION', from: current, to: next });
  }
}
```

> **H-P1-4:** This constant is in its own file `admin-kyc-state-machine.ts`. Import it in `AdminKycService` and `AdminKycService` tests. Do NOT inline it inside the service class.

```typescript
// admin-product.service.ts
async approveProduct(productId: string, adminUserId: string, req: Request): Promise<ProductDto> {
  const product = await this.adminProductRepository.findById(productId);
  if (!product) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND' });

  // INV-S7-21 — validate via state machine (MUST NOT bypass)
  this.productStateMachine.validateTransition(product.status, ProductStatus.ACTIVE);

  const oldStatus = product.status;

  await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.product.update({
      where: { id: productId },
      data: {
        status: ProductStatus.ACTIVE,
        approvedBy: adminUserId,
        approvedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
    await tx.eventOutbox.create({
      data: {
        eventType: 'ProductApproved',
        payload: { productId, productName: product.name, businessId: product.businessId, sellerUserId: ..., segment: product.segment, adminUserId } as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
        schemaVersion: '7.0',
        eventVersion: '1.0',
        deduplicationKey: `ProductApproved:${productId}:${adminUserId}`, // INV-S7-28
        status: EventStatus.PENDING,
      },
    });
    await this.auditWriter.safeWrite({
      actorId: adminUserId,
      action: AuditAction.STATUS_CHANGE,
      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: productId,
      entityName: product.name,
      oldValue: { status: oldStatus },
      newValue: { status: 'ACTIVE', approvedBy: adminUserId },
      ipAddress: req.ip,
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] as string,
    }); // H-P0-1: safeWrite() called OUTSIDE $transaction
  });

  // INV-S7-19 — notification OUTSIDE $transaction
  await this.notificationService.sendDirect(product.sellerUserId, 'ProductApproved_SELLER_hi', {
    productName: product.name,
  }).catch((err) => this.logger.error({ err, productId }, 'PRODUCT_APPROVED_NOTIFICATION_FAILED'));

  return this.adminProductRepository.findById(productId);
}
```

```typescript
async suspendUser(targetUserId: string, reason: string, adminUserId: string, req: Request): Promise<void> {
  // INV-S7-11 — self-modification check
  if (targetUserId === adminUserId) {
    throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'ADMIN_SELF_SUSPENSION_FORBIDDEN' });
  }

  const user = await this.adminUserRepository.findById(targetUserId);
  if (!user) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'USER_NOT_FOUND' });
  if (user.isDeleted) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'USER_ALREADY_SUSPENDED' });

  // INV-S7-10 — ALL THREE inside $transaction
  await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.user.update({
      where: { id: targetUserId },
      data: { isDeleted: true, deletedAt: new Date(), tokenVersion: { increment: 1 } },
    });
    await tx.loginSession.updateMany({
      where: { userId: targetUserId, revoked: false },
      data: { revoked: true, revokedAt: new Date(), revokeReason: 'ADMIN_SUSPENSION' },
    });
    await tx.eventOutbox.create({
      data: { eventType: 'UserSuspended', payload: { userId: targetUserId, userRole: user.role, reason, adminUserId } as Prisma.InputJsonValue, schemaVersion: '7.0', eventVersion: '1.0', deduplicationKey: `UserSuspended:${targetUserId}:${adminUserId}`, eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()), status: EventStatus.PENDING }, // INV-S7-38: eventMonth required
    });
    await this.auditWriter.safeWrite({ actorId: adminUserId, action: AuditAction.STATUS_CHANGE, entityType: 'User', entityId: targetUserId, entityName: user.phone, oldValue: { isDeleted: false }, newValue: { isDeleted: true, reason } }); // H-P0-1: OUTSIDE $transaction
  });

  // INV-S7-27 — cache invalidation AFTER commit
  await this.redis.del(`seller_biz:${targetUserId}`).catch(() => {});

  // INV-S7-19 — notification outside transaction
  await this.notificationService.sendDirect(targetUserId, 'AccountSuspended_SELLER_hi', {}).catch(() => {});
}
```

**Step 5.3:** Implement `AdminUsersController` with 5 routes

### AI Footguns — Phase 5

- **FOOTGUN-5-A:** Only setting `User.isDeleted = true` without `tokenVersion += 1`. Both required (INV-S7-10).
- **FOOTGUN-5-B:** Revoking sessions in a SEPARATE transaction from the user update. Must be one atomic transaction.
- **FOOTGUN-5-C:** Admin suspending themselves. The self-check must happen BEFORE the transaction.
- **FOOTGUN-5-D:** Deleting Redis cache INSIDE the transaction. Redis operations must be OUTSIDE the `$transaction`.
- **FOOTGUN-5-E:** Setting `User.role = 'ADMIN'` if agent uses `.string()` for Zod validation. Must be `.enum(['BUYER', 'SELLER'])` (INV-S7-12).
- **FOOTGUN-5-F:** Activating user and also decrementing tokenVersion. Activation does NOT change tokenVersion. User must re-login (this is intentional security behavior).

```typescript
// apps/api/src/modules/order/order-state-machine.ts
// ADD THIS FUNCTION — do NOT modify validateSellerTransition()

// // H-P2-4 HARDENED: Duplicate SHIPPED/DELIVERED entries removed. Single authoritative definition:
const ADMIN_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Partial<Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus[]>> = {
  // Forward transitions (admin-only gate):
  SHIPPED: [OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],    // SHIPPED can go DELIVERED or force-cancelled
  DELIVERED: [OrderStatus.COMPLETED, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],  // DELIVERED can go COMPLETED or force-cancelled
  // Force-cancel from early states:
  PLACED: [OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
  CONFIRMED: [OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
  PROCESSING: [OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
  PAYMENT_FAILED: [OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
};

const ADMIN_TERMINAL_STATES: OrderStatus[] = [OrderStatus.COMPLETED, OrderStatus.CANCELLED];

export function validateAdminTransition(
  current: OrderStatus,
  next: OrderStatus,
  reason?: string,
): void {
  if (ADMIN_TERMINAL_STATES.includes(current)) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'ORDER_TERMINAL_STATE',
      message: `Order is in terminal state ${current}. Admin cannot transition.`,
    });
  }
  if (next === OrderStatus.CANCELLED && !reason) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'CANCELLATION_REASON_REQUIRED',
      message: 'Reason is required for admin force-cancel.',
    });
  }
  const allowed = ADMIN_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[current] ?? [];
  if (!allowed.includes(next)) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'INVALID_ADMIN_TRANSITION',
      message: `Admin cannot transition from ${current} to ${next}.`,
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// admin-invoice.service.ts
async generateInvoice(orderId: string, adminUserId: string): Promise<TaxInvoiceDto | { invoiceId: string; status: 'GENERATING' }> {
  // Check if invoice already exists (idempotent)
  const existing = await this.adminPayoutRepository.findInvoice(orderId);
  if (existing) return this.toDto(existing);

  const order = await this.adminOrderRepository.findById(orderId, null);
  if (!order) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND' });

  // Calculate GST (INV-S7-14 — rates from FeatureFlag)
  const gstCalc = this.calculateGst(order);

  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Try synchronous generation first
  if (startTime > 0) { // always true — used as timing anchor
    const invoiceRecord = await this.createInvoiceRecord(order, gstCalc);

    const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;

    if (elapsed < 2000) { // INV-S7-16 — synchronous path
      const pdfBuffer = await this.generatePdf(invoiceRecord, order);
      const s3Key = `invoices/${orderId}/${invoiceRecord.id}.pdf`;
      await this.s3Service.uploadBuffer(pdfBuffer, s3Key, 'application/pdf');
      await this.prisma.taxInvoice.update({ where: { id: invoiceRecord.id }, data: { pdfUrl: s3Key } });
      return this.toDto({ ...invoiceRecord, pdfUrl: s3Key });
    } else { // INV-S7-16 — async path
      await this.invoiceGenerationQueue.add('generate-pdf', { orderId, taxInvoiceId: invoiceRecord.id, adminUserId });
      return { invoiceId: invoiceRecord.id, status: 'GENERATING' };
    }
  }
}

private calculateGst(order: OrderWithItems): GstCalculation {

}
```

```typescript
// calculatePayout(orderId, tx) — called from AdminOrderService.markComplete() (INV-S7-35)
// H-P1-9 FIX: flag values MUST be read BEFORE entering $transaction (not inside tx)
// Redis + DB calls inside $transaction risk 5s Prisma timeout and COMPLETED rollback.
async calculatePayout(orderId: string, order: OrderWithPayment, tx: TransactionClient): Promise<void> {
  // H-P1-9: Flags pre-fetched by caller BEFORE $transaction. Passed as arguments.
  // The caller (AdminOrderService.markComplete) calls:
  //   const [commissionPercent, tdsPercent, gatewayFeePercent] = await Promise.all([
  //     this.adminFlagService.getFlagValue('platform_commission_percent') ?? 2,
  //     this.adminFlagService.getFlagValue('tds_rate_percent') ?? 1,
  //     this.adminFlagService.getFlagValue('payment_gateway_fee_percent') ?? 2,
  //   ]);
  //   await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  //     await this.adminPayoutService.calculatePayout(orderId, order, tx, { commissionPercent, tdsPercent, gatewayFeePercent });
  //   });
}

async calculatePayoutInsideTx(
  orderId: string,
  order: OrderWithPayment,
  tx: TransactionClient,
  rates: { commissionPercent: number; tdsPercent: number; gatewayFeePercent: number },
): Promise<void> {
  const { commissionPercent, tdsPercent, gatewayFeePercent } = rates;

  const grossAmount = order.grandTotal;
  const platformFee = grossAmount.mul(commissionPercent / 100);
  const gatewayFee = grossAmount.mul(gatewayFeePercent / 100);
  const tdsAmount = grossAmount.sub(platformFee).mul(tdsPercent / 100);
  const netPayout = grossAmount.sub(platformFee).sub(gatewayFee).sub(tdsAmount);

  // H-P0-3 FIX: Order.sellerId = Business.id, SellerPayout.sellerId = User.id
  // MUST resolve Business.ownerId before creating payout
  const business = await tx.business.findUnique({
    where: { id: order.sellerId },  // order.sellerId is Business.id
    select: { ownerId: true },
  });
  if (!business) throw new Error(`Business not found for sellerId: ${order.sellerId}`);

  await tx.sellerPayout.create({
    data: {
      sellerId: business.ownerId,  // H-P0-3: Use Business.ownerId (User.id), NOT order.sellerId
      orderId,
      grossAmount,
      platformFee,
      paymentGatewayFee: gatewayFee,
      tdsAmount,
      netPayout,
      status: PayoutStatus.PENDING,
    },
  });
  await tx.platformCommission.create({
    data: {
      orderId,
      commissionPercent: new Prisma.Decimal(commissionPercent),
      commissionAmount: platformFee,
    },
  });
}
```

```typescript
// isEnabled(name, segment?) — used by other admin services for rate lookups
async isEnabled(name: string, segment?: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const cacheKey = `flag:${name}:${this.env}:${segment ?? 'global'}`;
  const cached = await this.redis.get(cacheKey).catch(() => null);
  if (cached !== null) return cached === '1';

  const flag = await this.adminFlagRepository.findByName(name, this.env, segment ?? null);
  const enabled = flag?.enabled ?? false;
  await this.redis.set(cacheKey, enabled ? '1' : '0', 'EX', 300).catch(() => {});
  return enabled;
}

// getFlagValue(name) — numeric FeatureFlag value
async getFlagValue(name: string): Promise<number | null> {
  // Store numeric values as rolloutPercent for MVP (reuse existing field)
  // e.g., platform_commission_percent flag: rolloutPercent=2 means 2%
  const flag = await this.adminFlagRepository.findByName(name, this.env, null);
  return flag?.rolloutPercent ?? null;
}

// toggleFlag(name, enabled) — admin action (INV-S7-18)
async toggleFlag(name: string, enabled: boolean, adminUserId: string, req: Request): Promise<FeatureFlagDto> {
  const old = await this.adminFlagRepository.findByName(name, this.env, null);

  await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.featureFlag.update({ where: { name }, data: { enabled } });
    await this.auditWriter.safeWrite({ ... }); // H-P0-1: OUTSIDE $transaction
  });

  // Cache invalidation — SCAN + DEL (INV-S7-18)
  await this.invalidateFlagCache(name);

  return this.toDto({ ...old, enabled });
}

private async invalidateFlagCache(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const pattern = `flag:${name}:${this.env}:*`;
  let cursor = '0';
  do {
    const [nextCursor, keys] = await this.redis.scan(cursor, 'MATCH', pattern, 'COUNT', 100);
    cursor = nextCursor;
    if (keys.length > 0) await this.redis.del(...keys).catch(() => {});
  } while (cursor !== '0');
}
```

**Step 9.3:** Implement `AdminFlagsController`

**Step 9.4:** Seed default FeatureFlags in AdminModule `onModuleInit` (or dedicated `AdminSeedService`):

```typescript
// H-P1-6 ADMIN BOOTSTRAP: Apps/api must have a mechanism to create the initial ADMIN user.
```

```typescript
// getBusinessExceptions() — business state queries (future separation point)
async getBusinessExceptions(): Promise<BusinessExceptionDto> {
  const [stuckOrders, failedPayments, suspendedSellersWithActiveOrders] = await Promise.all([
    this.adminOrderRepository.findStuckOrders(),        // status=PROCESSING, updatedAt < 24h ago
    this.adminPayoutRepository.findFailedPayments(),    // Payment.status=FAILED, no retry
    this.adminUserRepository.findSuspendedWithActiveOrders(),
  ]);
  return { stuckOrders, failedPayments, suspendedSellersWithActiveOrders };
}

// getTechnicalExceptions() — technical ops (future OpsService extraction point)
async getTechnicalExceptions(): Promise<TechnicalExceptionDto> {
  const dlqJobs = await this.notificationsFailedQueue.getFailed(0, 10);
  const dlqDepth = dlqJobs.length;
  return { dlqDepth, openDisputes: 0 }; // openDisputes placeholder for Sprint 8
}
```

## §31 AI-AGENT SAFETY RULES

### 31.1 All Documented Traps (Priority Order)

**P0 Security Violations (must be caught before code review):**

| Trap ID | Description | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| **AG-S7-P0-1** | `actorId` from request body instead of `req.user.id` | Admin impersonation attack |
| **AG-S7-P0-2** | `KycDocument.publicUrl` populated with signed URL | KYC document exposure |
| **AG-S7-P0-3** | `AuditRepository.update()` or `delete()` methods added | Audit tampering |
| **AG-S7-P0-4** | `ADMIN` allowed in `change-role` endpoint | Privilege escalation |
| **AG-S7-P0-5** | No self-modification check in `suspendUser`/`changeRole` | Admin account takeover |
| **AG-S7-P0-6** | Only `isDeleted=true` without `tokenVersion` increment in suspension | Suspended user retains JWT access |

**P1 Architecture Violations (caught at build/test time):**

| Trap ID | Description |
|---|---|
| **AG-S7-P1-1** | `SellerContextGuard` on admin routes |
| **AG-S7-P1-2** | `validateSellerTransition()` modified for DELIVERED |
| **AG-S7-P1-3** | `AdminModule` imports `OrderModule`, `SellerModule`, or any domain module |
| **AG-S7-P1-4** | `createAndEnqueue()` called from AdminModule directly |
| **AG-S7-P1-5** | `SellerPayout.orderId` given `@@unique` constraint |
| **AG-S7-P1-6** | Template body added to `update:` in `TemplateSeedService` |
| **AG-S7-P1-7** | AuditLog write outside `$transaction` when business state changes inside |
| **AG-S7-P1-8** | `SellerPayout.createPayout()` called outside `$transaction` that marks COMPLETED |

**P2 Business Logic Violations (caught at integration testing):**

| Trap ID | Description |
|---|---|
| **AG-S7-P2-1** | Hardcoded commission/TDS/gateway fee rates |
| **AG-S7-P2-2** | Floating point for financial calculations (use Decimal) |
| **AG-S7-P2-3** | PDF generation inside `$transaction` |
| **AG-S7-P2-4** | Automatic invoice on order COMPLETED (Sprint 9 scope) |
| **AG-S7-P2-5** | `POST /admin/tickets/:id/reply` implemented (Sprint 8 scope) |
| **AG-S7-P2-6** | Exception center results cached in Redis |

### 31.2 Common Mistakes Matrix

| Mistake | Wrong | Correct |
|---|---|---|
| Admin notification delivery | `AdminModule.BullMQModule.add('notifications', ...)` | `NotificationService.sendDirect(userId, templateName, vars)` |
| Admin audit log write | `this.auditRepository.create({...})` | `this.auditWriter.safeWrite({...})` |
| Admin order state change | `validateSellerTransition(current, next)` | `validateAdminTransition(current, next, reason)` |
| User suspension | Only `User.isDeleted = true` | `isDeleted=true + tokenVersion+=1 + LoginSession revoke` all in `$transaction` |
| Feature flag rate lookup | `const rate = 2;` | `await this.adminFlagService.getFlagValue('platform_commission_percent') ?? 2` |
| KYC document URL | `return { url: doc.publicUrl }` | `return { url: await this.s3Service.getSignedUrl(doc.url, 300) }` |
| Admin role check | `@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)` + `RolesGuard` | `AdminContextGuard` (no separate RolesGuard needed) |

### 31.3 Forbidden Patterns Summary

```typescript
// ❌ FORBIDDEN — domain module imports in AdminModule
import { OrderModule } from '../order/order.module';

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — actorId from body
const actorId = req.body.adminId;

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — publicUrl set for KYC docs
doc.publicUrl = signedUrl;

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — hardcoded rates
const commission = 0.02; // Must be from FeatureFlag

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — float math for money
const payout = order.grandTotal * 0.98; // Use Decimal

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — AuditRepository update/delete
await this.auditRepository.update({ where: { id }, data: { ... } });

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — unique on SellerPayout.orderId
@@unique([orderId]) // in SellerPayout model — use @@index

// ❌ FORBIDDEN — sendDirect inside $transaction
await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  await this.notificationService.sendDirect(...); // ❌ OUTSIDE only
});
```

## §33 DEGRADED-MODE BEHAVIOR

| Failure | Behavior | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| Redis unavailable | Feature flag reads fall back to DB. Admin rate limit skipped. Idempotency check skipped (risk: duplicate action). | Redis recovery auto-restores all caches. |
| DB unavailable | All admin routes return 503. | DB recovery resumes normal operation. |
| S3 unavailable | KYC document signed URL generation fails → 503 on `GET /admin/businesses/:id`. Invoice upload fails → 202 returned, BullMQ retry. | S3 recovery → BullMQ worker retries PDF upload. |
| AuditLog write failure | `AuditSafeWriterService` catches error, enqueues to `dead-letter` queue, logs CRITICAL. Business operation committed. | DLQ `dead-letter` worker retries audit write. |
| NotificationService.sendDirect() failure | Error logged. Admin action is committed. No rollback. | Manual re-send or DLQ replay. |
| BullMQ unavailable | Invoice generation fails for slow invoices (202 path). Notification delivery fails. Admin action itself unaffected. | BullMQ recovery → pending jobs resume. |
| `pdf-lib` PDF generation crash | Error caught. `TaxInvoice` record created (empty `pdfUrl`). Status: PENDING_PDF. BullMQ worker retry. | Manual re-trigger via `POST /admin/invoices/generate/:orderId` (idempotent). |

## §34 FUTURE COMPATIBILITY RULES

### Rules for Sprint 8 (RFQ/Disputes)

1. Sprint 8 MUST NOT import `AdminModule`. Sprint 8 creates its own domain modules.
2. `BusinessSuspended` and `BusinessVerified` EventOutbox events (now emitted) will be consumed by Sprint 8 RFQ eligibility filter. No Sprint 7 changes needed.
3. `openDisputes: 0` in exception center is a placeholder. Sprint 8 adds `Dispute` model and updates `AdminExceptionService.getTechnicalExceptions()` with one new query.
4. `SupportTicket` reply (`POST /admin/tickets/:id/reply`) deferred to Sprint 8 — requires `SupportTicketMessage` model migration.
5. `OUTBOX_EVENT_NOTIFICATION_MAP` has `ReturnInitiated` and `DisputeOpened` entries reserved for Sprint 8.

### Rules for Sprint 9 (Hardening)

1. `AdminFlagService.getFlagValue()` returns `rolloutPercent` as numeric rate. Sprint 9 adds proper percentage rollout evaluation.
2. `AuditLog` partition by `auditMonth` is a Sprint 9 PostgreSQL schema change. Sprint 7 prepares `auditMonth` key.
3. Automatic invoice generation on `DELIVERED → COMPLETED` is Sprint 9 scope. Architecture: add EventOutbox handler `OrderCompleted` that triggers invoice.
4. Bulk DLQ replay with rate limiting is Sprint 9 scope. Sprint 7 single-job replay remains unchanged.
5. `Notification.segment` DB field is Sprint 9 scope.
6. Admin 2FA (TOTP) is Sprint 9 scope.

### Multi-Seller Marketplace Rules

1. `SellerPayout.orderId` NEVER gets `@@unique` constraint — multi-seller requires N payouts per order.
2. `validateAdminTransition()` is a pure function — safe to call from multi-seller orchestration.
3. All admin queries that filter by `sellerId` use `Business.id` (not `User.id`).
4. KYC is per `Business` — one user can own multiple businesses (multi-seller ready).

### Security Hardening Summary

- **Suspended admin access window** (P1-7): INV-S7-36 now mandates `isDeleted` DB check in JwtStrategy. Zero window between suspension and access revocation (within request-boundary).
- **Payout FK integrity** (P0-3): `Business.ownerId` resolution before payout creation prevents FK violation and ensures correct seller identity in payout records.
- **KYC audit trail** (P0-2): All KYC document accesses logged with `AuditAction.UPDATE + metadata`. No PII access goes unrecorded.
- **Admin bootstrap** (P1-6): Env-var-driven bootstrap with zero-admin guard prevents unauthorized first-admin creation.

### Scalability Hardening Summary

- **Index migration** (P1-1): `idx_order_status_updated` now part of the required migration. Exception center stuck-orders query will not be a full table scan at scale.
- **Redis outside transaction** (P1-9): `getFlagValue()` called before `$transaction`. Eliminates risk of Redis latency causing Prisma 5s timeout rolling back `Order.COMPLETED`.

### AI-Agent Safety Hardening Summary

New/updated footguns added: FOOTGUN-1-E, FOOTGUN-1-F, FOOTGUN-3-D (KYC state machine file location). Ambiguous "or import directly" language replaced with definitive extract instruction. Duplicate code samples eliminated. Phase prerequisite notes added where ordering matters.

### Security Audit Report

| Attack Vector | Attempt | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Privilege escalation via role change | `AdminChangeRoleDtoSchema` rejects `ADMIN`/`SELLER_MANAGER` via Zod enum | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Admin self-suspension | Pre-transaction `targetUserId === adminUserId` check throws 403 | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Suspended admin JWT access | INV-S7-36: `isDeleted: false` filter in `auth.repository.ts:35` confirmed | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Audit log bypass | Direct `AuditRepository.create()` from admin services — FORBIDDEN by INV-S7-2 | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Audit log tampering/delete | `AuditRepository` has no `update()`/`delete()` methods (verified in source) | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Audit log replay | Each entry has `createdAt`, `sessionId`, `ipAddress` — replayability is informational only | ✅ ACCEPTABLE |
| KYC document leakage | `KycDocument.publicUrl` always null (INV-S7-8). Signed URL 300s TTL (INV-S7-9) | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Stale signed URL abuse | 300s max TTL. No persistent URL. Access logged via INV-S7-33 | ✅ MITIGATED |
| Double payout | `PlatformCommission.orderId @unique` + `Order.COMPLETED` is terminal state | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Payout seller identity fraud | P0-3 fix: `Business.ownerId` resolved in tx before `sellerPayout.create()` | ✅ BLOCKED |
| Feature flag abuse | Flag toggles require admin JWT + Idempotency-Key + AuditLog | ✅ AUDITED |
| Stale flag cache | SCAN+DEL pattern invalidates `flag:{name}:{env}:*` (wildcard on segment) | ✅ MITIGATED |

### Redis Governance Audit Report

| Key Pattern | Owner | TTL | Namespace Collision |
|---|---|---|---|
| `otp:{phone}` | OtpService | 300s | — |
| `ratelimit:otp:{phone}` | OtpService | 300s | — |
| `lockout:{phone}` | OtpService | 900s | — |
| `seller_biz:{userId}` | SellerContextGuard | 60+jitter | — |
| `admin-idem:{idempotencyKey}` | AdminIdempotencyGuard | 86400s | ✅ No collision |
| `flag:{name}:{env}:{segment}` | AdminFlagService | 300s | ✅ No collision |
| `admin-rate:{adminId}:{minute}` | AdminRateLimitGuard | 60s | ✅ No collision |

**Stale cache risk:** `flag:` keys cleared via SCAN+DEL on toggle. `seller_biz:` cleared on suspension. No stale-forever risk.

**Key collision analysis:** `admin-idem:`, `flag:`, `admin-rate:` — zero collision with Sprint 1–6 prefixes (otp:, ratelimit:, lockout:, seller_biz:, session:).

### Scalability Audit Report

| Scale Point | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 10 sellers | ✅ Trivial | All queries indexed |
| 100 sellers | ✅ Adequate | AuditLog partitioned by `auditMonth` |
| 1,000 sellers | ✅ Adequate | All payout/KYC queries indexed |
| 10,000 sellers | ⚠️ Monitor | AuditLog volume, EventOutbox backpressure |
| AuditLog growth | ✅ Mitigated | `auditMonth` partition key enables archival |
| Exception center queries | ✅ Mitigated | `idx_order_status_updated` index added (H-P1-1) |
| Feature flag reads | ✅ Mitigated | Redis cache TTL=300s, DB fallback |
| Payout processing | ✅ Mitigated | Atomic in `$transaction`; no background processing |

**10,000 seller note:** At this scale, the exception center `stuckOrders` query (`status=PENDING AND updatedAt < 24h ago`) benefits from the new composite index `(status, updatedAt)`. EventOutbox fan-out to multiple handlers may require review — deferred to Sprint 9.
